title: Walk in truth and love while guarding the teaching of Christ
image_prompt: Create a symbolic teaching-tableau for The elder urges the chosen lady and her children to walk in truth and love and warns against deceivers who deny Christ’s coming in the flesh., using the assigned passage 1:1-13 from this chapter as its focus. Set the frame in a plausible first-century eastern Mediterranean household church or teaching space: believers gathered around a messenger and a parchment letter, with visible everyday actions or restrained objects that convey the argument. Do not invent a specific scene as if the letter described it; use a carefully staged illustration of the passage’s central teaching and practical implications. Keep symbols understandable, historically grounded, and subordinate to the human focal point. Cinematic biblical storyboard realism with a clear focal subject, natural light and believable shadows, nuanced facial expressions, realistic anatomy, tactile stone, timber, clay, woven textiles, parchment, and local vegetation. Use the historical period and geography appropriate to the passage. Interpret metaphors and visions with restraint, do not invent details that contradict the text, and do not depict God as an ordinary visible human figure. No modern objects, contemporary clothing, printed captions, speech bubbles, watermarks, fantasy armor, or gratuitous violence.
